_readme: Manual card->TCGplayer product overrides for the TCGCSV main-price sync. Each entry replaces the Scrydex payload's product-id claim for that card and is exempt from collision blocking and number verification (a human verified the product). Confirmed by Stephen 2026-08-25. Spec: docs/tcgcsv-main-price-migration-spec-2026-08-25.md.
